fusions.name: Venom Down the Line
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Short Leash
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Shared Shackle
fusions.desc: Links you to your attackers: for 6 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: One Leads to Another
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, a sting leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 5 damage, then on to 1 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 3 seconds.
